1. (Currently amended) A cleanable, waterborne polyurethane dispersion comprising the reaction product of: A) one or more OH-functional acrylic dispersions and B) one or more polyisocyanates modified with 3-(cyclohexylamino)-propanesulfonic acid (CAPS) and/or 2-(cyclohexylamino)-ethanesulfonic acid (CHES).

2. (Currently amended) The dispersion of claim 1, wherein component A) comprises at least two different OH-functional acrylic dispersions.

3. (Currently amended) The dispersion of claim 1, wherein component B) comprises at least one polyisocyanate modified with CAPS and/or CHES, wherein said polyisocyanate is derived from an aliphatic diisocyanate.

4. (Original) The dispersion of claim 3, wherein the aliphatic diisocyanate is 1,6-diisocyanatohexane.

5. (Original) A method of producing a cleanable coating on a substrate comprising applying the dispersion of claim 1 to the substrate and curing the coating composition.

6. (Original) A coating produced according to the method of claim 5.

7. (Currently amended) The coating of claim 6, wherein the surface energy of the coating is greater than 31.0 dynes/cm, as measured by contact angle analysis.

8. (Currently amended) The coating of claim 7, wherein the surface roughness of the coating, measured as root mean square roughness, is greater than 200 nm.
